pipeline_stages.description: Load OSM building footprints from Overpass JSON
pipeline_stages.input: Overpass 'out geom' JSON (way + relation elements with embedded geometry)
pipeline_stages.output: List[TileBuilding] with BuildingPolygon parts (outer + inner rings)

pipeline_stages.description: Assign each building to exactly one tile by footprint centroid
pipeline_stages.output: TileAssignment { tiles: Dict[(tx,ty), List[TileBuilding]], unplaceable: List[TileBuilding] }
pipeline_stages.algorithm: Area-weighted centroid of (outer - inners) per part, projected to XODR-local frame via _FWD_TRANSFORMER (bare tmerc). Cell index = floor((local_x - origin_x) / tile_size). Half-open upper bound on cells.

pipeline_stages.description: Emit per-tile OSM XML with whole buildings (no mid-polygon cuts)
pipeline_stages.output: OSM XML file with nodes/ways/relations + stats dict
key_features: coordinate deduplication by rounded lat/lon (1e-7 precision)
simple way for single-part no-holes; multipolygon relation for multi-part or holes
member ways carry no tags; tags on relation for multipolygons

pipeline_stages.description: OSM2World converts tile OSM XML to OBJ (visual clutter only)
Blender imports OBJ, exports FBX for UE4/CARLA
pipeline_stages.manifest_generation: J3 manifest with object inventory, hashes, export options
pipeline_stages.fbx_roundtrip: Re-import in clean Blender to validate inventory integrity

pipeline_stages.description: Re-import FBX in clean Blender, compare inventory to original manifest
UE4.26 Import.py loads FBX into CARLA Large Map
warnings_observed: degenerate tangent bases which will result in incorrect shading
missing smoothing group information in FBX

coordinate_frames.blender_fbx_export: FBX in Blender local space (axis_forward=-Z, axis_up=Y, global_scale=1.0)
coordinate_frames.ue4_import: FBX imported with CARLA coordinate conventions
coordinate_frames.critical_note: Verified chain: OSM2World emits bare tmerc metres (verified in GEOMETRY_PRECISION_AUDIT.json: tile coordinates are large absolute map values). Blender's OBJ import preserves coordinates unchanged, and the FBX is exported with axis_forward='-Z', axis_up='Y', global_scale=1.0. The tile centroid partition, however, is computed in tile-local metres via TileGridSpec with header_offset_xy=(832671.676, 5458671.104), so the partition frame and the mesh frame differ by that fixed offset. That offset is unchanged by this work.
